ownerReportedActions.source: Owner reported completed physical vehicle tests in this case conversation
ownerReportedActions.applicationProfile: 4.61.6-4647, last deployed profile; no fresh device/version inspection in this reporting step
unsupportedOnThisVehicle: seat ventilation: owner confirms the vehicle does not have this feature
scopeLimits: Rear trunk closing outcome does not identify whether MOVE or explicit CLOSE was used; explicit CLOSE remains prepared and further testing is not required
Air-conditioning group report is retained without claiming individual climate/defrost/recirculation/bioweapon/keeper/overheat action and parameter coverage
Seat and steering-wheel heating report does not cover all seats, levels, automatic modes, or off direction
No new USB-disconnected, exact temperature, raw phone receipt, or current installed-version evidence was supplied
ownerReportedActions.untestedScope: Owner explicitly does not require further testing of untested items; keep them untested and do not schedule follow-up trials
ownerReportedActions.verifiedActionCountScope: Twelve actions in the original archive, not this eight-action development subset

navigationDeviceValidation.source: Actual ordinary phone Agent rollout, both one-shot receipts, exact App UUID/sourceContext telemetry, and owner confirmation in that rollout
navigationDeviceValidation.firstInputTransformation: Agent replaced supplied store name with a web-searched street/shop address; owner saw residential complex as first result
navigationDeviceValidation.secondInputTransformation: Agent prepended store name to that address; owner confirmed the destination was now correct
problemsFound: Skill imposed full address and parked/nearby vehicle confirmation
Agent expanded the supplied place and removed its name on the first request
Generic Bluetooth disconnected status was misread despite Tesla-associated LE connection in the same dump
A manually generated UUID was not substituted into a quoted JSON example, causing a harmless check failure
correction: Pass through supplied destination keywords, store names or addresses; ask only when destination is absent
Ordinary navigation instruction authorizes one send without parking, P-gear or proximity confirmation
Use the matching App outcome, not generic Bluetooth profiles, to report delivery
Allow the JSON entrypoint to allocate the request UUID and return it before invoking the unchanged one-shot pipeline
navigationDeviceValidation.validationScope: BLE delivery and one corrected store destination confirmed; keyword-only matching and nearby ordering are not physically confirmed

historicalResults.qualification: Owner observations and App receipts have distinct scope. The original 22-to-21 temperature report is not strictly correlated to one saved request timestamp; source action metadata is retained without creating a new request-to-vehicle claim.

target.execution: Existing root Agent command tool, no Magisk/su dependency

migration.reused: Original command recipes, encode/decode verification, JSON argument-array entrypoint, atomic one-shot namespace and UUID/sourceContext App-result reader
changed: Use team shared REA Node pack instead of private Device Lab runtime
Read widget ID and host package from private binding instead of fixed widget 5 / Pixel Launcher
Use standalone host build and on-device installer instead of legacy IoT lab deployment
Restrict runtime catalog to eight historically used actions; all target statuses remain prepared
Use CommonJS .cjs under the team repository ESM package
Bluetooth-only command adapter; no Owner API fallback
notAdded: Tesla account login or phone-key provisioning
migration.versionAndMaterialChecks: The executor checks installed package versionName/versionCode, and hashes the separately prepared public APK used for encoding. It does not hash the currently installed APK; the future operator must compare that base APK to the locked material before replay.

excluded: Tesla APK and native/Node runtime binaries
